content: ‘Walewalehiu po amamau, ona lautanigana ma u matami tau biugei u baha a baheya.’
Lawahi hi lautanigana ma Paulo mi Yudeya ponahigei i ibaabani yaka hi genuwana imahi. Ma i wibaabani i pa,

‘Tau lawa Yudeyagei. Ma Silisiya u tupona meyagai gowana Tasasi ugolina hi guniu, ma tamogi u Yelusalem a lata, po hougana a ihewali Gameliyela ugolina a wisikulu po googata hai lugagayo ugolinei hi wiatatiyeu. Ma a wileta duma po Yaubada ugolina a palipalihalena meu mei gasi atapumi amalai.
Guyau Yesu tu wotagona a ihiniwiyuwahi po hi hilahilage. Ma ololoto po wiwine a womomohihi po hau numa panipani a hauluiyehi.

Tu witalaguyaba hai taniwaga po tu wikaha babadahi emoemotana awai a bahebaheya hina wikawamoineya. Tauhi mi Yudeya lawahi u Damaseko hi mamae hai pepa hi gilumihi po ipa a niyehi. Ega yaka a nenae noka hosi po Guyau Yesu tu wotagona ipa gulawa pawapawasigei a panipanihi po a neihi mai u Yelusalem po hina wimihehi.
‘Ma a nenae po iyeta bolinai hougana Damaseko a tutuliyaliyani ma mala emosi ma yayata baneina yadei i hopu mai po i yayata wiiwileu.
Ma a peu hopu hau hipuli ma lawa ponana a noonoli ma i pa, “Saulo! Saulo! Awai binei e ihiniwiyuwau?”
‘Apoma tau a lubayada a pa, “Guyau, tam iyai?” ‘Ma lawana i pa, “Tau Yesu Nasaletagei ma houga daodaona e ihiniwiyuwau.”
Lawa mitehi to nenae naka yayatana hi galeya ma tamogi Yesu i bahabaha mai ugoliu anona ega hita hanapugeya.
‘Ega yaka a lubayada a pa, “Guyau, apo awai a dewaya?” ‘Ma Guyau ugoliu i baha mai i pa, “Una wotowolo po Damaseko una luiya po noka hosi tahaya bimgei Yaubada i woononogogeya apo hina paliwelem.”
Noka hougana yayatana a kadidili ugolina ma matau i apapoe. Ega yaka tu witulaniu hi lunimaniu po Damaseko to luiya.
‘Noka hosi Yaubada tu wotalagiyena po Mose a lugagayo tu wotagona gowana Ananaya i mamae, ma Yudeya lawahi u Damaseko tu mae hi iyateyateya.
Tauna i nei po u liyaliyau i towolo ma i pa, “Walehiu Saulo, una galena meme.” Noka kabudalana ugolina a galena meme po Ananaya a galeya.
‘Ma ugoliu i baha mai i pa, “Googata hai Yaubada i winaganim po ipa a nugotuhu una hanapugeya ugolinei a Tu bagibagi dumadumaluna Yesu amaka u galeya, po ponana amaka u nonoli,
matababana tam apo a tu baha moina lawa atapuhi ugolihi awai u gagaleya po awai u noonoli binei.
Ma geka kabudalana awai e ototoni? Una towolo po bapatiso una waya ma Guyau gowanei una lupali po am apapoe ina oga halehi.
‘Ega yaka a gunawilena meu Yelusalem po numa dalabu baneina u hinena a tapatapalolo po enogagalena a gagaleya.
Enogalena u hinena Guyau a gagaleya ma i pa, “Una bulili yagiyagina po geka dobuna una nehaleya babana tau biugei ma am wibaabani apo hina wihinigigiyeya.”
‘Apoma a pa, “Guyau hi hanapugena dumaya naka tau a nae po numa dalabu atapuhi ugolihi tu witumaganem a panipanihi po a ilawihi.
Po gasi am tu baha Sitibeni hougana hi ununi naka tau u liyaliyahi a mamae. Omunugona a kawaidewedeweya po tu’munugohi hai kaleko a tamihi.”
‘Ma Guyau i baha mai ugoliu i pa, “Yelusalem una nehaleya po una nae tauhi ega mi Yudeya ugolihi, po tam hai tu wituwetuwega.” ’
Paulo apo hita wilawi
Lawa hi genuwana ma hi lautanigana naka i nei po tauhi ega mi Yudeya bahana ugolina ma hi wootuotugena meya hi pa, ‘Ta uni haleya. Lawa geka pite ega ita dumalu ipa ina lauyagohana.’
Ma uyohi i gigai po hi iototu ma hai luilui hi loolohi ma aehigei hipuli hi tutugoiya.

Yohola hi lauuyogigai ma tu wigawiyahi hai taniwaga a hewahewali i baha po Paulo hi awala niyeya hai ani mae ugolina. Ma i baha po hi kodikodili ipa ina bahena meya awai binei ma mi Yudeya hi luuyogigai ugolina.

Ega yaka aena ma nimana hi panipanihi po i kokoe. Ma ipa hina wilawi. Ma Paulo gawiya kapenana ugolina i baha nae i pa, ‘Tau lawa Lomagei babana u Tasasi hi guniu Loma a u ani taniwaga ma ata lugagayo i baheya ipa luhetala ina tahaya ma taumi ipa ona wilawiu?’
Hougana gawiya kapenana geka bahana i noonoli po i nae hai taniwaga ugolina i lubayada i pa, ‘Awai ipa una dewaya noka lawana ugolina? Tauna lawa Lomagei.’
Ega yaka hai taniwagana i nae po Paulo i lubayadeya i pa, ‘Moina tam Loma lawana?’ Ma Paulo i pa, ‘Ee, tau lawa Lomagei.’
Apoma taniwagana i pa, ‘Tau ega mi Loma natuhi ma mone baneina Loma tanitaniwagahi a welehi ma a lui u hinehi.’ Ma Paulo i pa, ‘Tau mi Loma natuhi babana u Tasasi hi guniu.’

Ega yaka tu wilawina mala emosi ma Paulona hi nehaleya. Ma tu wigawiyahi hai taniwaga i gagalena tuhaga po i matouta duma, matababana lugagayo i tulagoni po Paulo Loma lawana ma i baha po aena po nimana hi panipanihi.
Paulo i luhetala tu wiwogatala u matahi

Tu wigawiyahi hai taniwaga a nugotuhu baneina ipa ina hanapugeya awai binei mi Yudeya Paulo hi igouya. Yaka malitom ma i baha po tu witalaguyaba babadahi po tu wiwogatala atapuhi hi’mboina gogona. Apoma Paulo hau numa panipani i wihaleya po niyeya po u naohi i witowoli.
